output: [PSI-102] ranks highest with a score of 54/100 because it covers the detection focus, tests solid habitat materials like silicone and Kapton, includes ventilated airflow, and offers strong data richness with 8 test rows and 4 measurement types. [PSI-101] ranks second with 50/100 by also covering detection and solid habitat materials like foam and Kapton, achieving the highest richness score with 109 test rows and 5 measurement types despite unreported airflow. [PSI-60] ranks third with 28/100 because, although it covers the detection focus, it tests gaseous fuels without habitat materials and provides much lower data richness with only 2 measurement types and no experimental table.
